BiblicalUsage: Chaph is pure, clean, and it appears once, in Elihu's report of Job's claim: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent, and there is no iniquity in me.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single verse shows how dangerous a true word can be when it is used to defend a false case.
